sources.title: Sekai MCP — Create AI Games with Codex and Claude Code
sources.snippet: Sekai for people who build with AI Sekai MCP: make a game with your AI. Connect Codex, Claude Code or Cursor to Sekai MCP, the official Model Context Protocol server for Sekai. Ask your AI coding assistant to build you a game. It uses Sekai's own library of art, music and sound, and puts the finished game straight into your Sekai drafts — you open it in the app and publish when you're happy ...
